# Rafvex

> Technology, AI, Guides & Knowledge. Comprehensive technical masterclasses, hardware reviews, operating system optimizations, and research workflows.

Website: https://rafvex.com
Sitemap: https://rafvex.com/sitemap.xml
RSS Feed: https://rafvex.com/feed

## Core Topic Categories
- [Artificial Intelligence & Tools](https://rafvex.com/category/ai-tools): Generative models, local LLMs, prompt engineering, and research tools.
- [Computing: Windows & Mac](https://rafvex.com/category/windows-mac): OS performance tuning, terminal productivity, and developer environments.
- [Mobile: Android & iPhone](https://rafvex.com/category/android-iphone): Mobile hardware security, storage troubleshooting, and cross-platform workflows.
- [Security & Privacy](https://rafvex.com/category/basic-online-security): Hardware security keys, travel OpSec, authentication, and threat modeling.
- [Hardware Reviews](https://rafvex.com/category/reviews): Empirical evaluations of mice, laptops, headphones, and peripherals.
- [How-To & Troubleshooting](https://rafvex.com/category/troubleshooting): Step-by-step diagnostics for Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, battery, and system failures.
- [Websites & Software Apps](https://rafvex.com/category/websites-apps): Knowledge vaults (Obsidian/Notion), reference management, and open-source tools.
- [English Reading Stories](https://rafvex.com/category/english-reading-stories): Literary narratives, linguistic study editions, and vocabulary mastery.
- [Technology News Dispatches](https://rafvex.com/news): Real-time analysis of cybersecurity advisories and frontier AI releases.

Configure OsmAnd, optimize dual-band GNSS accuracy, preserve battery power, and ensure zero data loss.

- [Why You Must Stop Reusing Passwords and How to Switch to a Password Manager](https://rafvex.com/article/stop-reusing-passwords-switch-password-manager): Stop reusing passwords. Understand credential stuffing economics, master zero-knowledge Argon2id encryption, and execute a seamless password manager migration.
- [Authenticator Apps vs SMS Verification: How to Properly Secure Your Accounts](https://rafvex.com/article/authenticator-apps-vs-sms-verification-security): SMS verification leaves you vulnerable to SIM swapping. Upgrade to open-source TOTP authenticators (Aegis, 2FAS) and hardware FIDO2 security keys.
- [How to Spot Fake Emails and Suspicious Links Before Clicking](https://rafvex.com/article/how-to-spot-fake-emails-suspicious-links): Detect sophisticated academic spear-phishing, predatory conference scams, and spoofed review requests. Inspect email headers and defeat credential harvesting.
